""" Web scraper for extracting API documentation from HTML pages. This initial implementation provides basic HTML parsing functionality that will be evolved to handle complex documentation structures. The LLM will have access to actual documentation pages through optillm's readurls plugin, allowing it to understand the specific HTML structure and improve the parsing logic accordingly. """ from bs4 import BeautifulSoup from typing import Dict, List, Optional import re # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START # HYPOTHESIS-1: Prioritizing dt.sig elements and extracting their dd siblings will increase completeness by capturing more complete function info # MECHANISM-1: Sphinx/API docs use dt for signatures and dd for descriptions - processing these first with full context yields better data # EXPECT-1: completeness > 0.38 # RESULT-1: REFUTED (actual=0.325) # HYPOTHESIS-2: Filtering out invalid function names (single chars, common words) will improve accuracy by reducing false positives # MECHANISM-2: Generic text like "a", "the", "if" get matched as functions, lowering precision - stricter validation improves accuracy # EXPECT-2: accuracy > 0.78 # RESULT-2: REFUTED (actual=0.7222222222222222) # HYPOTHESIS-3: Using a dict keyed by name instead of list prevents duplicates and improves both accuracy and completeness scores # MECHANISM-3: Duplicates dilute metrics - dict ensures unique entries while preserving best version of each function found # EXPECT-3: combined_score > 0.72 # RESULT-3: REFUTED (actual=0.6863888888888889) def scrape_api_docs(html_content: str) -> List[Dict[str, any]]: """ Extract API documentation from HTML content. Args: html_content: Raw HTML content of a documentation page Returns: List of dictionaries containing function documentation """ soup = BeautifulSoup(html_content, "html.parser") func_dict = {} # Use dict to prevent duplicates # Strategy 1: dt.sig elements (highest quality - Sphinx docs standard) for dt in soup.find_all("dt", class_="sig"): sig_name = dt.find(class_="sig-name") if sig_name: name = sig_name.get_text(strip=True) if is_valid_function_name(name): signature = dt.get_text(strip=True) desc = extract_description(dt) func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": signature, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(signature), } # Strategy 2: Headers with function signatures for tag in ["h2", "h3", "h4"]: for header in soup.find_all(tag): text = header.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if is_valid_function_name(name) and name not in func_dict: desc = extract_description(header) func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } # Strategy 3: Code blocks (lower priority) for code in soup.find_all("code"): text = code.get_text(strip=True) if "(" in text and ")" in text: name = text.split("(")[0].strip() if is_valid_function_name(name) and name not in func_dict: desc = extract_description(code) func_dict[name] = { "name": name, "signature": text, "description": desc, "parameters": extract_parameters(text), } return list(func_dict.values())[:25] def is_valid_function_name(name: str) -> bool: """Check if a string is a valid function name.""" if not name or len(name) < 2: return False # Exclude common words and invalid patterns invalid = {"the", "a", "an", "if", "or", "and", "is", "in", "to", "of", "for"} if name.lower() in invalid: return False # Must start with letter or underscore if not (name[0].isalpha() or name[0] == "_"): return False return True def extract_description(element) -> str: """Extract description text from element's siblings or children.""" # Try dd sibling (Sphinx pattern) if element.name == "dt": dd = element.find_next_sibling("dd") if dd: text = dd.get_text(strip=True) if text: return text[:300] # Try next paragraph next_p = element.find_next_sibling("p") if next_p: text = next_p.get_text(strip=True) if text: return text[:300] # Try parent's next sibling if element.parent: next_elem = element.parent.find_next_sibling() if next_elem and next_elem.name == "p": text = next_elem.get_text(strip=True) if text: return text[:300] return "No description found" def extract_parameters(signature: str) -> List[Dict[str, str]]: """Extract parameter information from a function signature.""" params = [] match = re.search(r"\((.*?)\)", signature) if match: param_string = match.group(1).strip() if param_string: # Split by comma, handle basic cases for part in param_string.split(","): part = part.strip() if not part or part in ["...", "*", "**"]: continue # Extract name (before : or =) name = re.split(r"[=:]", part)[0].strip() if name and len(name) > 0: # Extract type if present param_type = "unknown" if ":" in part: type_match = re.search(r":\s*([^=]+)", part) if type_match: param_type = type_match.group(1).strip() # Extract default if present default = None if "=" in part: default = part.split("=")[-1].strip() params.append({ "name": name, "type": param_type, "default": default, "description": "", }) return params def format_documentation(api_docs: List[Dict[str, any]]) -> str: """ Format extracted documentation into a readable string. Args: api_docs: List of API documentation dictionaries Returns: Formatted documentation string """ output = [] for doc in api_docs: output.append(f"Function: {doc['name']}") output.append(f"Signature: {doc['signature']}") output.append(f"Description: {doc['description']}") if doc.get("parameters"): output.append("Parameters:") for param in doc["parameters"]: output.append(f" - {param['name']}: {param.get('description', 'No description')}") output.append("") # Empty line between functions return "\n".join(output) # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END # Example usage and test if __name__ == "__main__": # Sample HTML for testing basic functionality sample_html = """
json.dumps(obj, indent=2)

Serialize obj to a JSON formatted string.

json.loads(s)

Deserialize s to a Python object.

""" docs = scrape_api_docs(sample_html) print(format_documentation(docs)) print(f"\nExtracted {len(docs)} functions")
